summary: S-411 UI re-smoke on LIVE preprod after backend D17 fix. Frontend-only. CASE 1 (advance at check-in only) PASSED end-to-end via UI — the ₹500 Card advance is persisted and shown on the folio. CASE 2 (booking advance + check-in advance) is INCONCLUSIVE via UI because the NewBookingPage does NOT expose an advance-payment input in the current build (only 8 inputs: nb-name, nb-phone, nb-email, nb-adults, nb-children, nb-checkin, nb-checkout, nb-amount — no nb-advance/booking-advance/deposit). I ran an additional confirmation via a fresh booking Smoke 411D on r1 (advance at check-in only ₹500 Card) which also PASSED with Advance Paid ₹500 / Balance ₹1,600 — matching Case 1.

case_2_411C_r5_booking_advance_1000_plus.reason: The NewBookingPage in the current build exposes NO advance-payment input on the form. Enumerated all 8 visible inputs post-room-selection: nb-name, nb-phone, nb-email, nb-adults, nb-children, nb-checkin, nb-checkout, nb-amount. There is no nb-advance / booking-advance / deposit / prepayment field. Therefore the ₹1,000 booking advance cannot be entered from the UI. My initial run put a value in the wrong input (I mistakenly filled the 2nd placeholder=0 which mapped to something else) so the folio for 411C shows Advance Paid ₹0 / Balance ₹2,100 — but this is a test-script/UI-availability issue, not a D17 regression.

ui_bugs.issue: No advance-payment input field on New Booking form. S-411 second case (advance at booking + advance at check-in must sum to ₹1,500) is not testable end-to-end from the UI because there is no way to record a booking-time advance. Either the field is missing/hidden or must be added with a data-testid like nb-advance.
Both ci-amount and ci-advance share placeholder="0" — this makes generic selectors unreliable. This is only a testability nit; the data-testids ci-amount and ci-advance work correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: D17 backend fix is VISIBLE in the UI for the check-in-advance flow: CheckInPage payload (advance_payment + payment_method) is being persisted, folio Advance Paid renders correctly (₹500 for 411B and 411D), and the Payments Received section shows a proper ledger row 'card · Advance · <date> · ₹500'. Balance math is correct (2,100 − 500 = 1,600).
GuestFolioPage still renders a single 'Lodging GST' line without SGST/CGST split — same BUG-418 as prior iterations. Not a S-411 blocker but still open.
CheckInPage GST block correctly splits CGST 2.5% + SGST 2.5% before submit; consistent with iter 3 finding.
